clean_room_attestation.note: All exported commercial_clean LightGBM and Ridge models were trained strictly on pure primary-sequence features or MIT structRFM embeddings against experimental wet-lab assay readouts. ViennaRNA v2.8.0 is isolated to optional [research] dependencies and never used to generate features or labels for any commercial_clean artifact.

exported_model_artifacts.training_dataset: GSE232927_top25k_paired (Castillo-Hair et al. 2024 HEK293T polysome profiling)
exported_model_artifacts.feature_family: 36 pure primary-sequence 5'UTR composition, uAUG/uORF, Kozak, G4/homopolymer, and 16 dinucleotide features

exported_model_artifacts.training_dataset: Wu2019_293T_endogenous (Wu et al. 2019 eLife HEK293T SLAM-seq/timecourse)
exported_model_artifacts.target_column: decay_293t_endogenous (experimental endogenous mRNA decay rate / stability)
exported_model_artifacts.feature_family: 77 pure primary-sequence CDS length, GC1/2/3, 5' ramp, CpG/UpA, CAI, and 61 sense codon frequency features

exported_model_artifacts.training_dataset: Saluki_AgarwalKelley2022_HumanConsensus (39-study human mRNA half-life PC1 + GENCODE v49 primary transcripts)
exported_model_artifacts.feature_family: 79 pure primary-sequence 5'UTR + CDS + 3'UTR length, GC3, CAI, ARE/Pumilio/PAS motifs, and 61 sense codon features
51 pure primary-sequence 3'UTR ARE/nonamer/Pumilio/Roquin-CDE/PAS/homopolymer, 16 dinucleotide, and 15 key trinucleotide features

exported_model_artifacts.training_dataset: GSE139176 (Mauger et al. 2019 PNAS Firefly luciferase SHAPE-MaP across U, 5moU, m1Psi) & GSE232927
exported_model_artifacts.target_column: experimental per-nucleotide SHAPE-MaP reactivity (U / moU / mpU) & experimental rl_mean
exported_model_artifacts.feature_family: 768-d base embeddings from MIT structRFM_checkpoint (Zenodo 16754363, USE_SPACED=False, zero BPfold)
